name: Our understanding
summary: How a proposal restates what the client asked for: a single statement, situation to ask, quoted requirements, objectives and measures, scope and assumptions, drivers around the ask, RFP traceability, a dense one-page restatement and a two-slide context and scope pair.

body.text: Northfield's RFP asks for one partner to redesign how patients are scheduled, registered and billed, and to carry the change through to measurable cash and experience results.

body.body: A single scheduling and registration experience across all seven hospitals and 64 clinics.
Common front-end, claims and denial processes that cut days in A/R and rework.
A partner accountable from design through adoption, not only for delivery.

body.text: “We want a partner who owns the outcome, not the work plan.”
